output.review_comment:
Two of the three changes are fine. Checking that `slot_minutes` divides 1440 evenly and wrapping 24:00 to 00:00 both follow the docstring.

The rounding change should not be merged. The PR description says the original round-half-up formula matched the docstring ("halfway times round up to the later boundary"). It also says the switch to banker's rounding was made only so `test_morning_standup_half_hour_slot` (09:15 → 09:00) would pass, and that nothing in the docs describes this behavior. That means the code now contradicts its own documentation to satisfy one test's expected value. You said the docstrings are the source of truth, so this is the wrong fix. It also changes how every halfway time is snapped, depending on whether the slot index is odd or even. That's a surprising behavior change for any caller relying on the documented half-up rule.

Suggested path: keep the original half-up rounding, `(2*minutes + slot_minutes) // (2*slot_minutes)`, and add the divisibility check and the `% MINUTES_PER_DAY` wrap. Then report to the teammate that `test_morning_standup_half_hour_slot` conflicts with the docstring (by the docs, 09:15 should snap to 09:30). Either the test's expected value or the spec needs to change, and the team should decide which, rather than the code quietly working around it. Leave that test failing and flag it, instead of adding a special rounding rule just to make it pass.
